title: Slice Culture Media
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfzzjp76
materials: MEM Eagle medium, Hanks salts + 2 mM L-glutamine (Sigma M4642 or equivalent)
Calcium chloride dehydrate (Sigma C3306 or equivalent)
Magnesium sulfate heptahydrate (Sigma M1880 or equivalent)
Insulin from bovine pancreas, 10 mg/ml (Sigma I0516 or equivalent)
P200 pipette tips (Rainin GPL200F or equivalent)
250 ml sterile filter unit 0.22 µm PES (Sigma S2GPU02RE or equivalent)
Warning: Personal Protective Equipment () should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary equipment and thaw the serum.

substeps.instruction: Obtain a stir bar and place it in a container.
Thaw premeasured (20-80 ml) heat-inactivated Horse serum in a water bath.

steps.title: Prepare Base Solution
steps.instruction: Combine water and dry reagents while stirring.

substeps.instruction: Measure 190 ml of MilliQ Water using a graduated cylinder and add it to the container with the stir bar.
Place the container on a stir plate and begin stirring.
Weigh 1.68 g of MEM Eagle medium, Hanks salts + 2 mM L-glutamine using a calibrated balance and add slowly to the container while stirring.
Weigh 36 mg of Ascorbic Acid using a calibrated balance and add slowly to the container while stirring.

steps.title: Add Liquid Reagents in Sterile Hood
steps.instruction: Move the container into a sterile hood and add the following liquid components using a serological pipette or P1000/P200 pipettes:

substeps.instruction: Add 6 ml of HEPES (solution should turn pink).
Add 3.36 ml (or 840 µl four times) of NaHCO3, 892.75 mM solution.
Add 2.25 ml (or 750 µl three times) of D-glucose.
Add 1 ml of penicillin/streptomycin 5,000/L.
Add 500 µl of GlutaMAX I.
Add 200 µl of 2 M MgSO4.
Add 100 µl of 2 M CaCl2.2H2O.
Add 100 µl of Insulin from bovine pancreas, 10 mg/ml.
Pour 40 ml of heat inactivated Horse serum into the container, using a P200 to recover any remaining liquid in the tube.

steps.title: Adjust pH and Osmolarity
steps.instruction: Verify and adjust the chemical properties of the media.

substeps.instruction: Measure the pH using a calibrated pH meter and adjust to 7.2-7.3 using 1 M Tris base.
Measure the osmolarity of a 10 µl sample using a calibrated Osmometer.
If osmolarity is not 300-305 mOsm/kg, recalibrate the Osmometer and retest; if still out of range, remake the media.

steps.title: Filter and Store Media
steps.instruction: Sterilize the media and store it under appropriate conditions.

substeps.instruction: Filter the media through a Millipore 250 ml 0.22 µm filter system in the hood.
Label the bottle with reagent name, date, and preparer’s initials.
Place the media in an incubator at 35⁰C.
Note: Media must be prepared 3 days prior to use and expires 2 weeks from the date of preparation.

steps.title: Clean Up
steps.instruction: Clean the equipment used during preparation.

substeps.instruction: Wash the stir bar with MilliQ Water.
Place all used beakers and graduated cylinders in the dirty bins.
